title.suggested: Tom Allen's Free Concert Hall Advertised

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat carried a notice for Tom Allen's Free Concert Hall at 417 Washington Avenue, 'best place of amusement in the city,' open every evening with the champion presiding.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The St. Louis Democrat, Wednesday, October 8, 1873 (Daily Democrat). Notice is in the City News column.

facts.fact: Allen's Free Concert Hall at 417 Washington Avenue was open every evening, with Allen presiding

notes: Same notice as 481, repeated the next day.
